items.title: 23.2.1 Carbonyl group ki banawat aur reactivity (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the structure and reactivity of the carbonyl group (PDF 103-104).

blocks.text: Carbonyl group mein carbon aur oxygen dono sp2 hybridised hain. Carbon oxygen se double bond aur do doosre groups se single bonds se jura hai, aur group hamwar (planar) hai. Group polar hai: zyada electronegative oxygen par juzwi manfi charge (delta-) aur carbon par juzwi musbat charge (delta+) hai.

items: Carbonyl carbon apne delta+ charge ki wajah se electrophilic hai, is liye nucleophiles us par hamla kar sakte hain.
Double bond addition kar sakta hai kyunke pi bond aasani se toot'ta hai; group ki hamwar shakal carbonyl carbon ko bheer se khaali rakhti hai, jo addition mein madad deti hai.

blocks.text: Aldehydes ketones se do wajuhaat se zyada reactive hain. Pehli, ketone mein do alkyl groups ka electron dene wala (inductive) asar carbonyl carbon par musbat charge kam karta hai, is liye nucleophiles us par kam aasani se hamla karte hain. Doosri, ketone ke do alkyl groups hamla aawar nucleophile ke raaste mein aate hain (steric hindrance). Nucleophiles ki taraf reactivity: methanal > doosre aldehydes > ketones.

blocks.explanation: CH3CH2CH(CH3)CHO; CH3CH2COCH2CH3; (CH3)2CHCH2CHO; (CH3)2CHCOCH2CH3, jis ka durust IUPAC naam 2-methylpentan-3-one hai (doosre sire se number karne par kam number milta hai).

blocks.prompt: (CH3)3CCOCH3, (CH3)3CCOC(CH3)3 aur (CH3)2CO ko nucleophiles ki taraf barhti reactivity ki tarteeb mein likhein.
blocks.explanation: (CH3)3CCOC(CH3)3 < (CH3)3CCOCH3 < (CH3)2CO: carbonyl carbon par groups jitne bhari, steric hindrance utna zyada aur reactivity utni kam.

items: C=O: sp2, hamwar, polar (C delta+, O delta-).
Electrophilic carbon aur tootne wala pi bond: nucleophilic addition.
Aldehydes > ketones (inductive effect aur steric hindrance).
